meta.name: repo-intake-and-plan
meta.description: Rigor Intake helper for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to scan a repository, read the README and common project files, extract documented commands, classify inference, evaluation, and training candidates, and return the smallest trustworthy reproduction plan to the main orchestrator. Do not use for environment setup, asset download, command execution, final reporting, paper lookup, or end-to-end orchestration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描仓库并生成最小可复现计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从GitHub仓库快速提取命令并制定复现方案
copy.tagline_en: Scan a repo and generate a minimal reproduction plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract commands from a GitHub repo and create a reproduction plan

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先扫描仓库，读取 README 等文件，提取文档中的命令，并分类为推理、评估、训练等，最后给出最小的可信复现计划。
howto.when: 在复现任务开始时，需要先了解仓库结构和文档命令时触发。不要在执行命令或设置环境时使用。

say.text: 先扫描这个仓库，告诉我有哪些可用的命令。
say.note: Claude 会读取 README 并列出命令。

say.text: 帮我分类这个仓库中的推理、评估和训练命令。
say.note: Claude 会提取并分类命令。

say.text: 给出最小的可信复现计划。
say.note: Claude 会推荐最简复现步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans the repository, reads README and common files, extracts documented commands, classifies them into inference, evaluation, training, etc., and returns the smallest trustworthy reproduction plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of a reproduction task when you need to understand the repo structure and documented commands. Do not use during execution or environment setup.

say_en.text: Scan this repo and tell me what commands are available.
say_en.note: Claude reads README and lists commands.

say_en.text: Classify the inference, evaluation, and training commands in this repo.
Give me the smallest trustworthy reproduction plan.
